additional_info.subject: RE: ID0432013-DC/Si-D/CH- [MP / R4 170001800] HMI Panel CRM:00798002266
additional_info.body:
Dear Julian,
thank you for your message. I fully understand your concerns, particularly with regard to the situation in front of the customer.
However, I would like to point out that the Sicharge D is already covered by an extended warranty period with 24 months, which exceeds the standard ZRG warranty of 18 months for such cases for 6 Months. In this context, Headquarters is unable to authorize any further warranty extension. This extended coverage is already considered a significant goodwill gesture by both Regional Management and the customer.
Please rest assured that Headquarters takes recurring technical issues with elevated fault rates very seriously. In such cases, warranty extensions are granted for specific, clearly identified problems. These are continuously monitored by the factory and the quality department. For the Sicharge D, this includes, for example, display delamination and TDK-related issues, which are covered even beyond the standard warranty period.
In the present case, however, no such warranty extension has been approved by Product Care.
Additionally, I have reviewed the service history of the affected charger and found only this single ticket. Based on this, we cannot conclude that the device is affected by a general quality issue.
I understand that this may not be the response you were hoping for. Nevertheless, we must also take into account the post-warranty service business and the fact that technical products may fail after the warranty period has expired. In this case, the charger has been in operati
